missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Железо' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Металл' is the nominative predicate noun, and 'тяжёлый' is the agreeing masculine adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Железо' is the accusative direct object of 'производит'; as a neuter noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Завод' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Железа' is genitive after 'много' to express a large amount. 'В руде' is the prepositional location naming where it is.
Strategic focus: Genitive of material. 'Железа' is genitive after 'из' to name the material. 'Мост' is the nominative subject, and 'сделан' is the short-form participle.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Железу' is in the dative case after 'к' to show attraction toward. 'Магнит' is the nominative subject of 'притягивается'.

missions.phrase: Они работают с железом каждый день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Железом' is in the instrumental case after 'с' to mean working with it. 'Каждый день' marks the routine.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В железе' uses the prepositional form 'железе' after 'в' to say what is contained inside. 'Примесей' is the genitive plural after 'много'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Железа' is genitive modifying 'цена' to mean the price of iron. 'Выросла' agrees with 'цена' in feminine gender.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Железо' is the accusative object of 'содержит', identical to nominative as a neuter noun. 'Кровь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Железо' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Старое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'во дворе' is the prepositional location.
